facts.condition: For a two-receiver channel whose relabeling symmetry exchanges the receiver marginals, orbit-averaging turns the lesser of the two separately relaxed UV branches into the balanced UV scalar. Because that balanced scalar tensorizes, finite repetitions of the half-skew BSSC cannot strengthen this particular converse by coupling coordinates, even with block-level priors and concavification variables.

assumptions: The canonical half-skew BSSC has the receiver-exchange relabeling needed for the symmetry argument.
The fact concerns only this UV converse route and does not assert an exact sum-capacity value.
The two UV branches are independently relaxed scalar bounds; they are not the complete jointly constrained UV region.
